As requested by viewers, we discuss the Riemann Hypothesis proof with James Maynard, a Fields Medalist and expert on Prime Numbers - More links & stuff in full description below ↓↓↓

Professor Maynard is based at The University of Oxford: https://www.sjc.ox.ac.uk/discover/people/professor-james-maynard/

More related Numberphile videos...

More videos featuring Fields Medalists: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLt5AfwLFPxWIDErJihuPX2S7E-0rnkaeu
